dog.description_text: Winnie is the cutest, perfect sized mix breed pup! She’s a 6 month old, 27 pound Husky/Chihuahua/Lab Mix who is smart, sweet and goofy! She loves kids, giving kisses, cuddling, playing with other dogs and adventures, she loves to play but also crashes for nap time. She is housebroken, knows commands and loves treats. She’s working on her leash manners, puppy habits and enjoying her crate. She is smart and very affectionate and is super friendly with all dogs and people, and was in a home with young kids who she ADORES! She was almost adopted, but the older dog in the house was not a fan of puppy energy and it’s effecting their every day life, now she is in need of a foster or even better a foster to adopt home to welcome her in as soon as possible!
dog.name: Winnie
